reading: Joined by the term: Zid's dashboard section العملاء (ZD-S-1036, لوحة التحكم > العملاء) and its Merchant APIs > Customers (ZD-S-0033) name the store's customers as Salla's Customers (SA-S-1693, /customers) and Shopify's Customers section (SH-S-1515) do. Strained by the dry run's rule S1: the concern's plan lines are cited in other trees, Add Business Customers (ZD-I-0348) in CM-B2B-001, Customer Wishlist (ZD-I-0339) in CM-LOY-005, Points-Earning Customers (ZD-I-0351) in CM-LOY-004 and WhatsApp Login (ZD-I-0194) in CM-CUS-013 (tree CM-CUS-010); and customer.create (ZD-S-0066) is cited in CM-CUS-010 too. The concern is Zid's whole Customers section, a coarser grain than any of those; its record lands here, where its where statements are.

A reading, joined on role: Zid's تفعيل Google maps is a map service the merchant turns on for the store from the dashboard's settings (ZD-S-0969; ZD-I-0131, عام › تفعيل Google maps), as Salla's released feature google-maps-service (SA-S-3119) is a map service a store has by plan. Strained: neither statement says what the map serves in the store, so that it serves buyers' addresses, the capability's definition, is not stated for Zid (it is scope.tsv's reading: 'locating buyers' addresses'). Q1's gaps: which plans or permissions turn it on needs observation, and no API is held.

Joined by definition: Zid's إشعارات المخزون 'ميزة تتيح لعملائك التسجيل لتلقي إشعار تلقائي فور توفر منتج نفدت كميته' (ZD-S-1029) and its plan line 'Let customers subscribe to product availability notifications' (ZD-S-0924) are Salla's Back in stock alerts (SA-S-1754), whose storefront component takes 'product id that can visitor subscribe to its availability notification' (SA-S-1498). All its statements are cited here.

Joined by the term, at the parent's grain: the concern is Coupons and discounts (its terms Coupons; Add Discount Coupons; Discounts; Card Discount), coarser than coupons alone, so it lands in the parent Discounts, Shopify's Discounts (SH-S-1522) and Salla's خصم (SA-S-5028). Its statements are cited in this tree only: coupons in CM-MKT-002, the automatic discounts permission (ZD-I-0489) in CM-MKT-003, bank and card discounts (ZD-S-1030, ZD-S-0927, ZD-I-0225) in CM-MKT-018, and the plan line Discounts / الخصومات (ZD-I-0297) here. Strained: batch 2 cites its report statements in CM-ANL-001, another tree (the coordinator, after batch 2).

Moved to domain B, a reading: Zid's Bundle Offers / الحزم التسويقية are product bundles, 'Bundle multiple products into one package' (ZD-S-0928), resting on the number of pieces, not the cart's value (ZD-S-1032), and 'not ordinary discounts' (ZD-S-1033). Domain D's model holds no bundle capability, and B's CM-SEL-006 Product bundles holds Shopify's, Salla's and WooCommerce's bundles; B-zid already cites every statement of ZD-C-089 there, as core (scope.tsv names B under also). Landing it in D would make the same statements support core in two domains. Zid's API path under discounts (/discounts/bundle-offers, ZD-S-0106) and its Marketing group (ZD-S-0026) are why scope.tsv read it as MKT; the coordinator may land it in CM-SEL-006 by an amendment.

Joined by the term marketing at the root of marketing: Zid's product line Marketing Tools (ZD-S-0457) and staff permission manage.store.marketing, Manage store marketing (ZD-S-0466), as Salla's Marketing link (SA-S-1694) and Shopify's admin route marketing (SH-S-5176). The concern is Zid's whole Marketing & Growth Tools, coarser than its parts. Strained by S1: its Add Marketing Affiliates (ZD-S-0974) and affiliate plan lines (ZD-I-0514, ZD-I-0292, ZD-I-0294, ZD-I-0295, ZD-I-0296) are cited in CM-MKT-014, in the tree of CM-MKT-013, not under CM-MKT-005. Its SMS lines (ZD-I-0301, ZD-I-0304) sit in this tree (CM-MKT-007).

Joined by the term: Zid's محفظة العميل (ZD-S-0666) and Customer Wallets API (ZD-S-0030) are Salla's Customer wallet / محفظة العميل (SA-S-1820), the same words. The concern is the wallet with cashback (محفظة العميل والكاش باك), coarser than cashback alone, so it lands in the parent; its cashback statements are cited in CM-LOY-003, in this tree. A reading on grouping: Zid's dashboard puts the wallet under برامج الولاء (ZD-S-0666), loyalty programs, which is CM-LOY-004's, another tree (see notes). Strained: batch 2 cites its wallet report statements in CM-ANL-006, another tree (the coordinator, after batch 2).
Joined by the term: Zid's Loyalty Program / برامج الولاء (ZD-S-0027, ZD-S-0929) is Salla's Loyalty program (SA-S-1823). All its statements are cited here.

Joined by the term الإهداء: Zid's خاصية الإهداء (ZD-S-0966) and Salla's نظام الإهداء الرقمي (SA-S-2623), its Gifting (SA-S-1825). Strained: no Zid statement defines the feature, so that it is buying a product for someone else with a message and a card, the capability's definition, rests on the shared word only; Q1's gaps say which plans or permissions turn it on needs observation, and no API is held.

Joined by the terms: Zid's Product Questions & Answers and Review Management / إدارة التقييمات (ZD-S-0020, ZD-S-0921) are Salla's Reviews & questions (SA-S-1860) and its reviews_management, إدارة التقييمات (SA-S-2528): product reviews with product questions. The statements cited are all in this capability.

Joined by the terms: Zid's بوابة خدمة العملاء الذاتية, a self-service portal, with its Customer Portal Tickets (ZD-S-0934, ZD-S-0032), is Salla's Self-service system (SA-S-1861), its نظام التذاكر, 'يتيح للعميل رفع تذكرة أو متابعة حالة الطلب' (SA-S-2095); Zid's portal lets the store's customers review their orders and raise service or support requests (ZD-S-1039). Strained: its complaint statements, the link on Zid's site for a complaint against a store (ZD-S-0935) and the legal page Zid Stores' Customer Complaints (ZD-I-0413), are cited in CM-SUP-008, another tree.

Moved to domain A by the coordinator after A-zid: in Zid Assurance, Zid handles any complaints or inquiries against stores (ZD-S-0998), the platform as mediator, A's CM-TRU-020. Its WhatsApp order updates (ZD-S-0999) stay cited here in CM-NTF-001. Batch 2 had joined it with Salla's Complaints on role, a reading the move replaces.

Joined by the terms: Zid's Reports & Analytics / التقارير والتحليلات, its التحليلات, 'بيانات تحليلية توضّح أداء المتجر' (ZD-S-0971), and التقارير (ZD-S-1048), are Salla's analysis and reports (/reports/analysis, SA-S-3532; إحصائيات وتقارير أداء المتجر, SA-S-2102). The concern is the whole section, so the parent; its reports are cited in CM-ANL-002 and its dashboard permission in CM-ANL-003, in this tree. B-zid cites its line Product Cost Report (ZD-I-0253) as shows in CM-CAT-012, domain B, that products carry a cost.

Joined by the terms: Zid's notifications, its order status messages رسائل حالات الطلب (ZD-S-0953) and Team Notifications / إشعارات الفريق (ZD-S-0954), are Salla's Notifications and notification settings (SA-S-1701, SA-S-2416): messages the store sends automatically to customers and staff. The concern holds both, so the parent; its team notifications are in CM-NTF-002 and its OneSignal settings and message balance in CM-NTF-004, in this tree. Strained: its settings entry التواصل › تنبيهات زد (ZD-I-0144) is cited in CM-MKT-022, another tree, since Zid says Zid Alerts target abandoned carts (ZD-S-1018).

Joined by the terms: Zid's Sender Name / اسم المرسل, 'Set the sender name in customer messages' (ZD-S-0957), is Salla's flags sender-name and sms-sender (SA-S-3352, SA-S-3344) and the sender IDs of its communication apps (SA-S-0193), in the delivery of the store's messages. Strained: batch 1 cites its ZD-S-1046 (promotional SMS go from a sender name ending in AD) in CM-MKT-007, another tree.

Joined by the terms: Zid's واتساب زد, built on the WhatsApp Business Platform API and linked to the store (ZD-S-0976, ZD-S-1054), with templates and a cost for each delivered message (ZD-S-1055, ZD-S-1057), is the WhatsApp channel of Salla's message delivery (communication.whatsapp.send, SA-S-1646). Its statements cited are all here. A reading: Zid calls it 'القناة الأمثل للتواصل مع عملائك' (ZD-S-0976); whether it carries conversations with buyers, CM-SUP-004's role, isn't stated.
